Ever heard of Gnome Sort? 🍄 It's hilariously simple, surprisingly effective, and might just be the most 'chill' sorting algorithm out there! Join us as we dive deep into how this quirky method sorts arrays by making them 'walk' their way to order. Perfect for beginners and anyone who loves a good coding laugh! 😂

* The intuitive logic behind Gnome Sort.
* How it compares to other sorting algorithms (like Bubble Sort & Insertion Sort).

* When (and why NOT) to use Gnome Sort.
